title: ORION: An Outcome-Driven LLM Advisor for RL-Based Multi-Domain 6G Slice Placement
title_zh: ORION：面向基于强化学习的多域6G切片部署的结果驱动型LLM顾问

paragraphs.en: Deploying 6G network slices across administrative domains requires an online decision for each arriving request: which domain hosts each virtual network function, how traffic crosses domain boundaries, and whether the slice is admitted. This joint decision problem is NP-hard under continuous arrivals. Experiments on a parametrized family of multi-domain topologies show that no fixed planning strategy dominates across all regimes: the performance ranking reverses between topology classes, and feasible placements exist for most rejected requests but remain undiscovered. These findings identify the plan layer as the decisive performance lever. We introduce ORION, a hierarchical orchestrator in which two LLM agents translate service intents into structured requests and generate abstract placement plans. A cooperative multi-agent RL coordinator selects the cross-domain partition, treating the plan as a persistent soft prior, while per-domain agents place the functions. ORION main contribution lies at the plan layer: an outcome-driven episodic memory that records, for each completed attempt, the network-condition profile, the proposed plan, and its verified feasibility outcome. The memory feeds verified successes and labelled failures back to the planner, thereby closing the adaptation loop using deployment feasibility rather than a scalar reward assigned to the planner’s own proposals. To isolate the effect of the plan quality, we evaluate the planner on held-out topology families while keeping the downstream selection and execution mechanisms fixed. Under this controlled setting, the proposed memory improves admission by 4.6 4.6 – 11.5 11.5 percentage points over the same planner without memory, while importance-based retention accounts for most of the improvement over a first-in-first-out store.

paragraphs.en: Network slicing enables a shared 6G physical infrastructure to be partitioned into multiple logical networks tailored to different service requirements [ 1 ] . Network function virtualization makes this possible: the functions that once ran on dedicated middleboxes are deployed as virtual network functions (VNFs) chained into a service function chain (SFC) and instantiated on commodity compute. In the multi-provider 6G setting considered in this work, the physical substrate spans multiple administrative domains rather than a single operator infrastructure. Each domain controls its own resource capacity and a subset of compute tiers—including RAN and edge sites, regional clouds, and central clouds—while inter-domain links are more constrained than intra-domain connectivity. Deploying a slice therefore requires determining which domain hosts each VNF in its service chain, how inter-VNF traffic is routed across domain boundaries, and whether the slice request should be admitted.
paragraphs.zh: 网络切片使共享的6G物理基础设施能够被划分为多个逻辑网络，以满足不同的服务需求 [ 1 ] 。 网络功能虚拟化使之成为可能：曾经运行在专用中间盒上的功能以虚拟网络功能（VNF）的形式部署，串联成服务功能链（SFC），并实例化在通用计算设备上。 在本文所考虑的多提供商6G场景中，物理底层跨越多个管理域，而非单一运营商的基础设施。 每个域控制自己的资源容量和部分计算层级——包括无线接入网（RAN）与边缘站点、区域云和中心云——而跨域链路比域内连接更加受限。 因此，部署一个切片需要确定服务链中的每个VNF由哪个域承载、VNF间流量如何跨域边界路由，以及是否应接受该切片请求。

sents.zh: 因此，部署一个切片需要确定服务链中的每个VNF由哪个域承载、VNF间流量如何跨域边界路由，以及是否应接受该切片请求。

paragraphs.en: These decisions must be automated. Slice requests arrive continuously and must be resolved online; each domain exposes aggregate state rather than per-node inventory across its management boundary, so the orchestrator plans without a global per-node view. This separation holds even under a single operator: a compact per-domain interface is what keeps orchestration scalable and domains independently operable. The QoS contract couples placement to routing, since a chain split across domains pays inter-domain propagation delay and consumes transit bandwidth that a co-located chain does not. The resulting joint placement, routing, and admission problem is NP-hard, generalizing both bin packing [ 2 ] and integer multi-commodity flow [ 3 ] . Exact formulations [ 4 ] are intractable online, whereas heuristics are fast but encode a fixed strategy that does not adapt when the substrate, workload mix, or load regime changes.
paragraphs.zh: 这些决策必须自动化。 切片请求持续到达，必须在线求解；每个域在其管理边界之外只暴露聚合状态而非逐节点清单，因此编排器在没有全局逐节点视图的情况下进行规划。 即使在单一运营商情况下，这种分离依然成立：正是紧凑的按域接口使编排具备可扩展性，并使各域可独立运营。 QoS 契约将放置与路由耦合在一起，因为跨域分布的链会付出域间传播时延，并消耗共置链无需消耗的转接带宽。 由此产生的联合放置、路由与准入问题是 NP 难的，它泛化了装箱问题 [ 2 ] 和整数多商品流 [ 3 ] 。 精确的公式化方法 [ 4 ] 无法在线求解，而启发式方法虽然快速，却编码了一种固定策略，当下垫网络、负载组合或负载状态发生变化时无法自适应。

paragraphs.en: Two lines of work address this challenge. Learning-based orchestrators replace fixed placement strategies with policies trained through interaction with the substrate [ 5 ] , but the resulting policies remain tied to the topology distribution seen during the training. Large language models have entered network management as intent translators [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] , and more recently as advisors that bias or guide a learned controller [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] . LLMs are well suited to this setting because they can reason over the abstract per-domain information that operators are willing to expose. At this level, identifying which tier assignments and cross domain partitions remain feasible for a given substrate structure relies more on operator expertise than on numerical optimization. However, existing approaches typically keep the LLM fixed after deployment. A smaller body of work allows the LLM to adapt online, but only through scalar performance feedback on its own proposals [ 14 , 15 ] . To our knowledge, none of these approaches conditions this adaptation on a verified feasibility outcome associated with a concrete plan and the network conditions under which it was evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: 有两条工作路线应对这一挑战。 基于学习的编排器用通过与底层网络交互训练得到的策略来取代固定的放置策略 [ 5 ] ，但所得策略仍然受限于训练时所见的拓扑分布。 大语言模型已作为意图翻译器进入网络管理领域 [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] ，最近还作为对学习型控制器进行偏置或引导的顾问 [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] 。 大语言模型非常适合这一场景，因为它们能够对运营商愿意暴露的抽象的按域信息进行推理。 在这一层面上，识别哪些层级分配和跨域划分对于给定的底层网络结构仍然可行，更多依赖运营商的专业经验而非数值优化。 然而，现有方法通常在部署后保持大语言模型固定不变。 较少的一部分工作允许大语言模型在线自适应，但仅通过对其自身方案的标量性能反馈来实现 [ 14 , 15 ] 。 据我们所知，这些方法都没有将这种自适应建立在经过验证的可行性结果之上，即与具体方案及其评估时的网络条件相关联的可行性结果。

paragraphs.en: We present ORION, a hierarchical orchestrator for multi-domain slice placement. Two LLM agents respectively translate the service intent into a structured request and propose an abstract placement plan. A multi-agent RL coordinator converts this proposal into a concrete cross-domain partition, treating it as a soft prior, while per-domain agents place VNFs and route their flows. ORION main contribution lies at the plan layer: an outcome-driven episodic memory records the network-condition profile, the proposed plan, and the verified feasibility outcome for each completed attempt, and feeds verified successes and labelled failures back to the planner. A diagnostic study on a parametrized family of topology identifies the plan layer as the effective point of intervention and motivates this design.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ORION，一个用于多域切片部署的分层编排器。 两个大语言模型智能体分别将服务意图翻译为结构化请求，并提出抽象部署方案。 一个多智能体强化学习协调器将该方案转化为具体的跨域划分，并将其视为软先验，同时各域智能体部署虚拟网络功能（VNF）并为其业务流选择路由。 ORION 的主要贡献在于方案层：一个以结果为驱动的情景记忆会为每次已完成的尝试记录网络状况画像、所提出的方案以及经过验证的可行性结果，并将验证过的成功案例和带有标签的失败案例反馈给规划器。 一项基于参数化拓扑族的诊断研究确定方案层是有效的干预点，并为本设计提供了动机。

paragraphs.en: This paper makes the following contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出以下贡献。

paragraphs.en: A verifier-based diagnostic study showing that planning failures primarily arise from search and routing limitations and that no fixed plan builder dominates across topology regimes.
paragraphs.zh: 一项基于验证器的诊断性研究，表明规划失败主要源于搜索与路由的局限，且没有任何固定的规划构建器能在所有拓扑条件下都占优。

paragraphs.en: Orion, a hierarchical architecture combining LLM-based planning, RL-based cross-domain partitioning under a soft-prior, and per-domain node placement.
paragraphs.zh: Orion 是一种层次化架构，它结合了基于 LLM 的规划、软先验下基于 RL 的跨域划分，以及每个域内的节点布局。

paragraphs.en: The rest of the paper is organized as follows. Section II reviews related work. Section III states the system model and the VNF placement problem. paragraphs.en: Multi-domain slice placement has been studied primarily as an optimization problem: given an SFC, a substrate partitioned into administrative domains, and a QoS contract, decide the VNF-to-domain assignment, the inter-domain routing, and the admission verdict. Exact formulations [ 4 ] and the heuristics that approximate them online share the property that the placement strategy is fixed in advance; learned orchestrators [ 16 ] make it adaptive but tie it to the substrate it was trained on. The recent turn to language models cuts across this axis, and it is that axis we use to organize what follows.

paragraphs.en: ORION couples its planner to the RL selector through a persistent soft prior, a mechanism we inherit from the value-based view of LLM-guided RL. [ 9 ] formulates the LLM as a prior over actions with formal guarantees and use it to steer value-based learning (LINVIT). [ 10 ] generalizes the LLM-as-prior idea through a variational objective, and [ 11 ] is recovered as the greedy limit of the same KL-regularized objective, grounding LLM proposals in a learned affordance value. In all three the LLM is fixed: it shapes the policy but never updates from what the policy does.
paragraphs.zh: ORION 通过一个持久的软先验将其规划器与 RL 选择器耦合起来，这一机制继承自基于价值的 LLM 引导 RL 视角。 [ 9 ] 将 LLM 形式化为动作上的先验并给出形式化保证，用它来引导基于价值的学习（LINVIT）。 [ 10 ] 通过变分目标将「LLM 即先验」的思想加以推广，而 [ 11 ] 可被视为同一 KL 正则化目标的贪婪极限，从而将 LLM 的提议建立在习得的可供性价值之上。 在这三项工作中，LLM 都是固定的：它塑造策略，但从不根据策略的实际表现进行更新。

paragraphs.en: The closest line of work is the LLM-augmented DRL approach to O-RAN slicing in [ 17 ] , a RAG-driven prompt-learning variant (ORAN-GUIDE) in [ 12 ] , and a prompt-tuned variant for dynamic slicing in [ 13 ] . Across these approaches, the LLM is trained or tuned offline and held fixed at deployment and does not report online adaptation based on the outcomes of executed controller decision. A second body of work adapts the LLM conditioning during deployment, making the distinction from ORION more subtle. For instance, [ 14 ] updates reasoning exemplars with realized action rewards and retrieve high- and low-reward cases into the LLM few-shot prompt to guide high-level action sequencing. [ 15 ] describes an agentic-AI framework for QoE-aware slicing in Industrial IoT whose incremental memory logs observed performance and folds it back into a retrieval-augmented intent-inference stage. Both approaches therefore exploit deployment feedback, but at different stages: [ 14 ] associates scalar rewards with action sequences, whereas [ 15 ] uses performance and QoE observations to refine intent inference. Neither conditions the LLM-based component on a verifier-checked feasibility outcome tied to a concrete plan structure and the network conditions under which it was evaluated, which is the signal stored by ORION episodic memory.
paragraphs.zh: 最接近的相关工作包括文献[ 17 ]中面向O-RAN切片的LLM增强DRL方法、文献[ 12 ]中基于RAG驱动的提示学习变体（ORAN-GUIDE），以及文献[ 13 ]中面向动态切片的提示调优变体。 在这些方法中，LLM均在离线阶段训练或调优，并在部署时保持固定，且均未报告基于已执行控制器决策结果进行在线自适应。 另一类工作则在部署期间对LLM的条件输入进行自适应，这使得其与ORION的区别更为微妙。 例如，文献[ 14 ]利用实际获得的动作奖励更新推理示例，并将高奖励和低奖励案例检索到LLM的少样本提示中，以引导高层动作排序。 文献[ 15 ]描述了一个面向工业物联网中QoE感知切片的智能体AI框架，其增量记忆记录观测到的性能，并将其反馈到基于检索增强的意图推断阶段。 因此，这两种方法都利用了部署反馈，但处于不同阶段：文献[ 14 ]将标量奖励与动作序列相关联，而文献[ 15 ]则利用性能和QoE观测来改进意图推断。 这两者都没有将基于LLM的组件条件化于与具体计划结构及其评估时所处网络条件相关联、且经验证器检验的可行性结果上，而这正是ORION情景记忆所存储的信号。

paragraphs.en: ORION’s memory follows the cognitive-architecture framing of CoALA [ 18 ] , which separates semantic, episodic, and procedural memory for language agents; our split between read-only operator knowledge ( K B K^{B} ) and read-write episodic outcomes ( M B M^{B} ) is a direct instance. General-purpose agentic-memory systems such as A-MEM [ 19 ] and Mem0 [ 20 ] supply lifecycle and extract-update pipelines for LLM-agent memory, but over conversational or task-completion traces. ORION differs in what is stored and to what end: entries are keyed on topology signature and record the plan shape together with its ground-truth feasibility outcome, so retrieval steers the planner toward strategies that verifiably survived under similar substrate conditions rather than toward dialogue or task-completion history.
paragraphs.zh: ORION 的记忆遵循 CoALA [18] 的认知架构框架，该框架为语言智能体区分了语义记忆、情景记忆和程序记忆；我们将只读的算子知识（K B K^{B}）与可读写的情景结果（M B M^{B}）分开，正是该框架的一个直接实例。 诸如 A-MEM [19] 和 Mem0 [20] 这类通用智能体记忆系统为 LLM 智能体记忆提供了生命周期以及提取-更新流水线，但其面向的是对话轨迹或任务完成轨迹。 ORION 的不同之处在于存储的内容及其目的：条目以拓扑签名为键，并记录计划形态及其真实可行性结果，因此检索会引导规划器走向那些在相似基底条件下被验证存活过的策略，而不是走向对话或任务完成历史。

paragraphs.en: ORION limits LLM inference overhead through a plan cache indexed by request signatures. Cached plans are revalidated before reuse and invalidated when the underlying conditions drift. We position this against Agentic Plan Caching [ 21 ] , which reuses plan templates at test time to cut LLM calls. Relative to it, our cache adds feasibility revalidation and drift-triggered invalidation on reuse; it is validated engineering for call economy, orthogonal to the outcome-loop contribution, and not claimed as novelty.
paragraphs.zh: ORION 通过以请求签名为索引的计划缓存来限制大语言模型推理开销。 缓存的计划在复用前会重新验证，并在底层条件发生漂移时失效。 我们将其与 Agentic Plan Caching [ 21 ] 进行对比，后者在测试时复用计划模板以减少大语言模型调用。 相对于该方法，我们的缓存增加了复用时的可行性重验证与漂移触发的失效机制；它经过验证，是面向调用经济性的工程实现，与结果循环的贡献正交，且并未声称为创新点。

paragraphs.en: Before presenting ORION, we identify where additional intelligence most affects admission. We use a parametrized multi-domain topology generator that varies domain capacity, tier coverage and inter-domain bandwidth. An exhaustive feasibility verifier enumerates placements under the complete constraints set, including load dependent M / M / 1 M/M/1 delays, VCR-dependent flow rates, and inter-domain hop limits. paragraphs.en: ORION processes each arriving request through three hierarchical layers, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . The LLM translates the service intent and proposes an abstract placement plan; the reinforcement learning-based multi-domain orchestrator (MDO) commits the function-to-domain assignment and admission decision; and per-domain actors place the assigned VNFs on concrete nodes.

sents.zh: 如图 1 所示，ORION 通过三个层次处理每个到达的请求。

paragraphs.en: Each arriving request is first turned into a structured slice by an LLM intent translator (Agent A, Section V-C ). An LLM plan layer (Agent B, Section V-C ) then reasons at the service and tier level over an abstract topology (per-domain aggregate residuals and inter-domain link summaries) and emits, for each VNF, a required tier and a suggested domain. Crucially, the LLM never sees per-node substrate state: domain residuals are summed over nodes, so single-node fitness is hidden from it by construction. This mirrors what a domain operator is willing to publish across an administrative boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 每个到达的请求首先由一个大语言模型意图翻译器（智能体 A，第 V-C 节）转化为结构化切片。 随后，大语言模型规划层（智能体 B，第 V-C 节）在一个抽象拓扑（按域汇总的聚合残差和域间链路摘要）上，在服务与层级层面进行推理，并为每个 VNF 给出所需的层级和建议的域。 至关重要的是，大语言模型从不看到每节点的基础设施状态：域残差是对节点求和的，因此单节点的适配性在构造上对其隐藏。 这模拟了域运营者在跨管理边界时愿意发布的信息。

paragraphs.en: An RL selection layer (the MDO coordinator, Section VI ) consumes the plan and assigns each VNF to a domain, learning where to deviate from the suggested partition; it observes per-domain residuals, the maximum single-node headroom per domain (which restores the node-level fitness signal the planner is denied), and the plan’s required tiers as a hard feasibility mask. The coordinator also routes the inter-VNF flows that cross domain boundaries and owns the admission decision. Here the abstraction is a property of the policy input , not of the routing mechanism: the coordinator selects partitions from the abstract inter-domain link summaries above, but at commit time it routes those flows and debits bandwidth on the full per-node substrate graph, since a concrete feasible path must exist for the admission verdict to be sound. What the learned policy never observes is per-node inventory; what the routing subroutine traverses is the concrete graph.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习选择层（即 MDO 协调器，第 VI 节）消费该规划，并将每个 VNF 分配到某个域，学习在何处偏离建议的分区；它观察各域的残差、每个域的最大单节点余量（以此恢复规划器无法获得的节点级适应度信号），以及规划所需的层级作为硬可行性掩码。 协调器还负责路由跨越域边界的 VNF 间流量，并掌握准入决策。 这里的抽象是策略输入的属性，而非路由机制的属性：协调器从上述抽象的域间链路摘要中选择分区，但在提交时它会路由这些流量，并在完整的每节点底层图上扣减带宽，因为必须存在一条具体可行的路径，准入判定才是可靠的。 学习到的策略永远不会观察每节点库存；路由子程序遍历的才是具体的图。

paragraphs.en: Relation to standardized management planes. The coordinator occupies the cross-domain management position and each domain actor a per-domain one, the roles informally called NSMF and NSSMF [ 23 ] , which 3GPP’s architecture framework places as an end-to-end management domain consuming services from per-domain ones [ 24 ] . Aggregate-only exposure across that boundary is the model those specifications assume, since a slice may be delivered with graded exposure of its internal structure or none at all [ 25 ] , and the same separation appears in ETSI NFV MANO, where per-domain resource control sits beneath an orchestration layer that does not address individual nodes [ 26 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 与标准化管理平面的关系。 协调者占据跨域管理位置，而每个域的智能体占据各自域内的位置，即通常非正式地称为 NSMF 和 NSSMF 的角色 [ 23 ]，3GPP 的架构框架将其定位为一个端到端管理域，消费来自各域管理域的服务 [ 24 ]。 这些规范所假设的模型是跨该边界仅暴露聚合结果，因为切片可以以对其内部结构的分级暴露方式交付，或完全不暴露 [ 25 ]；同样的分离也出现在 ETSI NFV MANO 中，其中各域的资源控制位于编排层之下，编排层并不直接处理单个节点 [ 26 ]。

paragraphs.en: Stated as an interface, the cross-domain protocol is small enough to write out in full. Downward , per arrival, a domain receives only its plan fragment: for each VNF assigned to it, the required tier and the CPU, RAM, and ingress-bandwidth demands, plus the bandwidth of any flow edge crossing its boundary. Upward , it returns a single triple ( z m , δ m , cost m ) (z^{m},\delta^{m},\mathrm{cost}^{m}) : a feasibility flag, the intra-domain delay it can offer, and the resource cost it would incur. Nothing else crosses. A domain never publishes node identities, per-node residual capacity, or its internal topology, and the signalling is O ⁡ ( K ) O(K) values per domain per arrival for a chain of K K VNFs, independent of the number of nodes it operates.

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 gives the end-to-end per-arrival pipeline: intent translation, constrained planning, structural validation, partition selection under the tier-feasibility mask, per-domain placement with inter-domain routing, single-shot commit, and the ground-truth verification that labels the outcome back into memory. The pre-commit check uses static per-hop delays while the verifier re-checks capacity, bandwidth, throughput, and end-to-end delay under load-dependent M/M/1 queueing; the residual between them is exactly the signal the outcome memory is designed to capture.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 给出了端到端的按到达请求流水线：意图翻译、约束规划、结构校验、在层级可行性掩码下的分区选择、带域间路由的每域放置、单次提交，以及将结果标注回记忆的真值验证。 提交前检查使用静态逐跳时延，而验证器在负载相关的 M/M/1 排队模型下重新检查容量、带宽、吞吐量和端到端时延；两者之间的残差正是结果记忆所要捕获的信号。

paragraphs.en: Agent A maps a natural-language service intent to a structured slice request: a JSON object giving the slice type (one of eMBB, URLLC, mMTC, V2X, XR), the VNF chain with per-VNF resource demands and volume-change ratios, the inter-VNF flow edges, and the QoS requirements. Translation is a single LLM call, conditioned on operator reference knowledge and past-translation examples drawn from Agent A’s own semantic store K A K^{A} and episodic store M A M^{A} ; the output is checked against the request schema and regenerated under a bounded retry budget on a schema violation.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体 A 将自然语言形式的业务意图映射为一个结构化的切片请求：一个 JSON 对象，给出切片类型（eMBB、URLLC、mMTC、V2X、XR 之一）、包含每个 VNF 资源需求和容量变化比例的 VNF 链、VNF 间的流量边，以及 QoS 需求。 翻译通过单次 LLM 调用完成，以运营商参考知识以及从智能体 A 自身的语义库 K A K^{A} 和情景库 M A M^{A} 中抽取的历史翻译示例为条件；输出会依据请求模式进行检查，若违反模式则在有界的重试预算内重新生成。

paragraphs.en: Agent B is a frozen, instruction-tuned LLM invoked once per arrival. Its context is assembled from four sources: the slice request (per-VNF resource demands, permitted tiers, per-flow bandwidth and QoS requirements), the abstract topology of Section V , reference entries retrieved from the semantic store K B K^{B} , and labelled examples retrieved from the episodic store M B M^{B} . It emits a JSON plan giving, for each VNF, a domain assignment and a required tier, and, for each flow, a minimum bandwidth and a cross-domain-boundary flag.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体 B 是一个冻结的、经过指令微调的大语言模型，每次到达时调用一次。 其上下文由四个来源组装而成：切片请求（每个 VNF 的资源需求、允许的层级、每条流的带宽与 QoS 要求）、第 V 节的抽象拓扑、从语义库 K B K^{B} 检索到的参考条目，以及从情景库 M B M^{B} 检索到的带标签示例。 它输出一个 JSON 计划，为每个 VNF 给出域分配和所需层级，并为每条流给出最小带宽和跨域边界标志。

paragraphs.en: Two mechanisms keep the plan measurable rather than free-form. First, decoding is grammar-constrained: each VNF’s domain field is restricted at sampling time to the domains whose tier support makes the VNF placeable, so the model cannot emit a tier-infeasible assignment. Second, ORION deliberately does not trust the LLM on the two fields where it can be silently wrong: the required tier and the cross-domain-boundary flag are recomputed from the substrate and overwrite whatever the model emitted, so they are advisory. Plan quality is therefore carried by the domain assignments and their induced cut points alone. A structural checker then validates the plan against aggregate per-domain capacity, tier eligibility, and inter-domain reachability before it reaches the selector; a structurally invalid plan is regenerated under a bounded budget, and, failing that, the slice is rejected.
paragraphs.zh: 两种机制使计划保持可度量，而非自由散漫的形式。 首先，解码受语法约束：在采样时，每个 VNF 的域字段被限制在那些其层级支持使该 VNF 可放置的域范围内，因此模型无法生成层级不可行的分配。 其次，ORION 刻意不在这两个容易悄然出错的字段上信任大语言模型：所需层级和跨域边界标志会根据底层网络重新计算，并覆盖模型生成的任何值，因此它们仅起参考作用。 因此，计划的质量仅由域分配及其产生的切分点决定。 随后，结构检查器会在计划送达选择器之前，针对各域的聚合容量、层级资格以及跨域可达性对其进行验证；结构无效的计划将在有界预算内重新生成，若仍失败，则拒绝该切片。

paragraphs.en: K B K^{B} is a read-only store of operator-authored infrastructure knowledge, curated offline and frozen before any experiment. Each entry pairs a topic and slice-type/topology tags with a free-text body; entries cover tier conventions, inter-domain link characteristics, known-good partitioning patterns, anti-patterns, and domain-specific properties, that is, the expertise a human operator would encode without access to deployment outcomes. Retrieval filters by slice-type and topology tag and ranks by lexical overlap, and the selected entries enter Agent B’s prompt as a reference block. K B K^{B} is identical across all LLM arms, so it is the fixed knowledge baseline the episodic store is measured against.
paragraphs.zh: K B K^{B} 是一个只读的、由操作员编写的基础设施知识库，在离线状态下整理而成，并在任何实验开始前冻结。 每个条目将一个主题与切片类型/拓扑标签配对，并附带自由文本正文；条目涵盖层级约定、域间链路特性、已知良好的分区模式、反模式以及领域特定属性，也就是说，这是人类操作员在无法获得部署结果的情况下会编码的专业知识。 检索按切片类型和拓扑标签过滤，并按词汇重叠度排序，被选中的条目作为一个参考块进入智能体 B 的提示词中。 K B K^{B} 在所有 LLM 分支中完全相同，因此它是情节存储所对照的固定知识基线。

paragraphs.en: M B M^{B} is the outcome-driven store that makes the advisor adapt, and it is the component the experiments isolate. Unlike K B K^{B} , it is written during operation. Each record pairs a topology signature and slice features with the plan shape Agent B produced (its co-locate or split strategy, per-VNF tier assignment, cross-domain cut points, and the inter-domain links used) and the plan’s ground-truth outcome: whether it survived feasibility verification, tagged by the dominant violation when it did not. Throughput-floor and end-to-end-delay violations are first-class tags, so topology-specific failure modes can be retrieved. The outcome is what makes the store outcome-driven: it gates which episodes are written and how they are labelled, while the topology signature drives what is retrieved. M B M^{B} is governed by four operations.
paragraphs.zh: M B M^{B} 是以结果为导向、促使智能体进行适配的存储库，也是实验所隔离的组件。 与 K B K^{B} 不同，它在运行过程中被写入。 每条记录将拓扑签名与切片特征，和智能体 B 生成的规划形态（其共置或拆分策略、每个 VNF 的层级分配、跨域切分点以及所使用的域间链路）以及该规划的真值结果配对：即该规划是否通过了可行性验证，若未通过则标注主导违约类型。 吞吐量下限违约和端到端时延违约被作为一等标签，因此可以检索特定于拓扑的失败模式。 正是这一结果使该存储库成为结果驱动的：它决定哪些回合被写入以及如何标注，而拓扑签名则决定检索什么内容。 M B M^{B} 由四种操作来管理。

paragraphs.en: ORION caches abstract plans using a key composed of the slice type, QoS bucket, and SFC template. paragraphs.en: The RL layer turns Agent B’s abstract plan into a committed cross-domain partition. It is a cooperative multi-agent system: an MDO coordinator that selects the partition under a soft prior from the plan, and per-domain actors that place VNFs on concrete nodes. The coordinator is a PPO agent over an enumerated joint-partition space; the actors are graph-attention networks, architecture-shared without weight-sharing, behaviour-cloned from a first-fit teacher and held fixed thereafter, so the learned variation across arms is confined to the coordinator and the plan layer. We describe the coordinator and its action space, the prior coupling that carries the plan into it, the domain actors, the representation choice that the joint action space embodies, and the training procedure and reward.

paragraphs.en: Agent B’s suggested configuration enters the coordinator’s objective as a KL regulariser over the joint action space, following the value-based view of LLM-guided RL [ 9 , 10 ] :
paragraphs.zh: 智能体 B 建议的配置作为联合动作空间上的 KL 正则项进入协调器的目标函数，遵循 LLM 引导的强化学习的基于价值的观点 [ 9 , 10 ]：

paragraphs.en: where π prior \pi_{\mathrm{prior}} is a temperature-softened joint distribution peaked on the suggested configuration m ~ t \tilde{m}_{t} . Both distributions are discrete categoricals over the same enumerated joint support, so the KL is evaluated in closed form and differentiated directly by autograd, which sidesteps by construction the Monte-Carlo gradient-estimator pitfalls that arise only when the KL is estimated by sampling. The weight β t \beta_{t} is annealed linearly toward a nonzero floor: strong early, so the plan guides exploration before the value estimate stabilises; reduced but never eliminated late, so the plan keeps advising even after the coordinator’s own advantage estimates mature. The KL term acts during training; at inference the suggested partition is retained as a decode-time bias on the coordinator’s action logits, so the LLM continues to advise the committed partition at decision time. The objective’s closed-form optimum reweights the plan prior by the exponentiated advantage; SayCan [ 11 ] is its greedy limit and unregularised RL its opposite limit, and ORION operates between them at the nonzero floor, with the decode-time bias carrying the plan into inference.
paragraphs.zh: 其中先验 π_{\mathrm{prior}} 是一个经温度软化、集中在建议构型 m ~ t \tilde{m}_{t} 上的联合分布。 两个分布都是定义在相同枚举联合支撑集上的离散类别分布，因此 KL 散度可以以闭式形式求值，并由自动微分直接求导，这从构造上规避了仅在通过采样估计 KL 时才出现的蒙特卡洛梯度估计器的种种陷阱。 权重 β t \beta_{t} 按线性退火趋近一个非零下限：早期较强，使计划在价值估计稳定之前引导探索；后期减弱但从不消除，使计划即使在协调器自身的优势估计成熟之后仍持续提供指导。 KL 项仅在训练期间起作用；在推理阶段，建议的划分被保留为协调器动作 logits 上的解码时偏置，因此 LLM 在决策时仍会继续为既定划分提供建议。 该目标的闭式最优解通过指数化的优势对计划先验进行重加权；SayCan [ 11 ] 是其贪心极限，而无正则化的强化学习则是其相反极限，ORION 在非零下限处运行于两者之间，并通过解码时偏置将计划带入推理阶段。

paragraphs.en: Each domain runs an actor on a strictly local observation, its own per-node residuals, intra-domain links, and the plan fragment assigned to it, and returns a compact response: a feasibility flag z m z^{m} and, when feasible, its intra-domain delay δ m \delta^{m} and resource cost cost m \mathrm{cost}^{m} . Concrete node and path selection stays internal to the actor and never crosses the domain boundary, which is what makes the abstraction gradient consistent as a policy-input hierarchy : the planner’s policy conditions on published aggregates, the coordinator’s on aggregates plus h m h^{m} , and only the actor’s on per-node inventory. The actor is a graph-attention network (GATv2) over the domain subgraph with residual bandwidth and propagation delay as native edge features, under architecture-sharing without weight-sharing so every domain uses the same architecture with its own parameters. Each actor is warm-started by behaviour cloning on a first-fit teacher, and the warm start passes a gated audit against the teacher before it is used, so execution starts from a competent, verified policy rather than from scratch. In all experiments reported here the audited actors are then held fixed , confining the learned variation across arms to the planner and the coordinator.

paragraphs.en: This section reports what is measured and states the protocol for what is not yet. We first ground the LLM stages with the measured call economy (Section VII-B ), then give the paper’s primary evidence for the memory claim: a plan-quality isolation on held-out topology families in which the selection and execution layers are held fixed, so the plan is the only varying factor (Section VII-C ). The full stack couples that plan into the trained MDO coordinator, which acts with the frozen behaviour-cloned domain actors of Section VI-C ; its evaluation follows the pre-specified protocol of Section VII-D , with results in the extended version. The diagnostic characterization that motivates this design is Section IV .

paragraphs.en: The two LLM stages are the dominant per-decision cost, and the architecture keeps them off the hot path by design. On the profiled deployment run (13,204 LLM calls over 32,435 RL decisions), a single LLM call takes a median 3.94 3.94 s and consumes a median 0.98 0.98 kJ of GPU energy, against 5.0 5.0 ms and 0.56 0.56 J for one RL selection decision, a gap of roughly 790 × 790\times in time and 1750 × 1750\times in energy per decision. The LLM accounts for 99.9 % 99.9\% of decision-path latency; retrieval ( 1.29 1.29 ms), memory write ( 3.87 3.87 ms), and routing ( 2.20 2.20 ms) are negligible beside it. A representative 20 20 -hour run draws 4.26 4.26 kWh end to end. The design implication is direct: invoke the LLM rarely (cache-gated, on signature miss or drift) and keep every downstream component cheap.
paragraphs.zh: 两个 LLM 阶段是每次决策的主要开销，而该架构在设计上让它们远离热路径。 在被剖析的部署运行中（32,435 次 RL 决策中共 13,204 次 LLM 调用），单次 LLM 调用的中位耗时为 3.94 3.94 秒，中位 GPU 能耗为 0.98 0.98 千焦，而一次 RL 选择决策仅需 5.0 5.0 毫秒和 0.56 0.56 焦耳，两者每次决策在时间上相差约 790 × 790\times，在能耗上相差约 1750 × 1750\times。 LLM 占决策路径时延的 99.9 % 99.9\%；检索（1.29 1.29 毫秒）、记忆写入（3.87 3.87 毫秒）和路由（2.20 2.20 毫秒）相比之下可忽略不计。 一次具有代表性的 20 20 小时运行端到端耗电 4.26 4.26 千瓦时。 设计上的启示很直接：尽量少调用 LLM（通过缓存门控，仅在签名未命中或漂移时调用），并让每个下游组件保持低成本。

paragraphs.en: Table II reports the isolation. Both reference rows are static co-location-first heuristics with first-fit fallback: Plain-ColocFB applies the rule directly, while RA-ColocFB is routability-aware, preferring splits whose inter-domain flows it can route. The two ColocFB rows are separated deliberately: both operate with full per-node visibility of every domain, which no LLM arm receives and which no deployable multi-domain orchestrator would have, since domains publish aggregate state across the management boundary (Section III ). They bound what is attainable with information the learned arms are denied by construction, and the comparisons that carry the claim are within the abstract-view block. Full- M B M^{B} admits more than the memory-off control on both seeds ( + 4.6 +4.6 and + 11.5 +11.5 points), and more than the FIFO- M B M^{B} ablation on both ( + 11.1 +11.1 and + 12.3 +12.3 points). With the selector fixed, the episodic memory therefore improves plan quality on topology families never seen during warm-up, and the gap to FIFO- M B M^{B} locates the advantage in which episodes are retained and retrieved rather than in the presence of a retrieval mechanism: an identical store under first-in-first-out admission loses most of the benefit. The sign is consistent across both seeds; the magnitude is not established.
paragraphs.zh: 表 II 报告了隔离性。 两个参考行都是带首次适配回退的静态「共置优先」启发式：Plain-ColocFB 直接应用该规则，而 RA-ColocFB 具有可路由性感知，优先选择其跨域流可被路由的切分。 两个 ColocFB 行是有意分开列出的：二者都拥有对每个域的完整逐节点可见性，这是任何 LLM 分支都不具备的，也是任何可部署的多域编排器都不会具备的，因为域在管理边界之外只发布聚合状态（第 III 节）。 它们界定了在学习型分支被构建性地剥夺这些信息的条件下所能达到的上限，而支撑核心结论的比较都在抽象视图块内进行。 在两个种子上，Full-Mᴮ M^{B} 的结果都优于关闭记忆的对照组（+4.6 和 +11.5 个百分点），也都在两项上优于 FIFO-Mᴮ M^{B} 消融（+11.1 和 +12.3 个百分点）。 因此，在选择器固定的情况下，情景记忆能在预热期间从未见过的拓扑族上提升计划质量，而与 FIFO-Mᴮ M^{B} 的差距表明优势在于保留和检索哪些情景，而不在于是否存在检索机制：同一个存储在先进先出准入策略下会失去大部分收益。 该符号在两个种子上一致；但幅度尚未确立。

paragraphs.en: An outcome-driven memory helps only where a better plan shape exists to be recalled. On routing-critical families, where admission turns on cross-domain cut points and inter-domain paths rather than on tier assignment, the memory’s advantage may invert, because the recalled plan shape does not transfer when the binding structure is the route, not the placement. We therefore pre-specify this as a boundary probe rather than an aggregate: the comparison is reported per family and scoped to the stress class, so a family where the mechanism fails is identified rather than averaged away.
paragraphs.zh: 结果驱动的记忆只在存在可供召回的更优方案形态时才有帮助。 在路由关键族上，录取取决于跨域割点和域间路径而非层级分配，记忆的优势可能反转，因为当约束结构是路由而非放置时，被召回的方案形态无法迁移。 因此我们预先将此指定为边界探针而非聚合指标：比较按族报告并限定于压力类，这样某个机制失效的族会被识别出来，而不是被平均掉。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we presented ORION, a hierarchical orchestrator for multi-domain 6G slice placement whose LLM planner adapts its context from verifier-checked feasibility outcomes associated with concrete plan structures and network conditions. Our diagnostic study showed that rejected requests are predominantly feasible but remain undiscovered, that fixed plan-building strategies do not perform consistently across topology regimes, and that improving the partition selector alone provides limited gains under sequential arrivals. In a controlled plan-quality evaluation on held-out topology families, the outcome-driven memory improved admission by 4.6 4.6 to 11.5 11.5 percentage points over the same planner without memory, while the full memory configuration consistently outperformed its FIFO variants. The latency measurements further show that LLM invocation dominates the decision time, motivating cache-gated plan reuse. A full-stack evaluation, including the reward-labelled-memory control and routing critical boundary analysis, is reserved for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 ORION，一种面向多域 6G 切片部署的分层编排器，其 LLM 规划器能够根据与具体计划结构和网络条件相关联的、经验证器核实的可行性结果来调整其上下文。 我们的诊断研究表明，被拒绝的请求大多是可行的但仍未被发掘，固定的计划构建策略无法在不同拓扑情形下保持一致的表现，而仅改进分区选择器在顺序到达场景下带来的收益有限。 在对留出拓扑族进行的受控计划质量评估中，结果驱动的记忆机制相较于同一无记忆规划器将准入率提升了 4.6 4.6 至 11.5 11.5 个百分点，而完整的记忆配置始终优于其 FIFO 变体。 时延测量进一步表明，LLM 调用在决策时间中占主导地位，这促使我们采用基于缓存门控的计划复用。 包括奖励标记记忆对照实验与路由关键边界分析在内的全栈评估将留待未来工作完成。
